title: BizFlood Endorsement Rules — Adding, Deleting and Revaluing Locations Mid-Term
content:
**Rule.** On BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), a location is added (location add), deleted (location delete) or revalued (value increase, value decrease) only on a policy whose status is pending effective or active. The policy is re-rated for the full term, and the change in the full-term premium multiplied by the days from the change effective date to term end divided by the days in the term, rounded to the cent, is booked as an endorsement premium item or, for a deletion or decrease, credited under the tier's credit method for deleted locations with the matching tax and stamping fee; the minimum earned premium does not apply to a mid-term deletion. A deletion takes effect on the date the signed request is received.

Each endorsement records the location, its address and flood zone, its building, contents and business income limits after the change, the date the change takes effect and the full-term premium as endorsed; the policy's location count, total insured value and term premium are updated to the endorsed figures.

## Status condition

| Policy status on the policy record | Location add, location delete, value increase or value decrease |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | Permitted |
| Active | Permitted |
| Expired | Not permitted |
| Cancelled | Not permitted |

The status is read from the policy record of the policy being endorsed.

## How the mid-term amount is defined

- **Full-term premium change** — the full-term premium after re-rating, compared with the full-term premium before the change; the difference is the change.
- **Mid-term amount** — that change multiplied by the number of days from the change effective date to term end, divided by the number of days in the term, then rounded to the cent.
- **Location add or value increase** — the mid-term amount is booked as an endorsement premium item.
- **Location delete or value decrease** — the mid-term amount is credited under the tier's credit method for deleted locations, together with the matching surplus lines tax and stamping fee. On a mid-term deletion the minimum earned premium does not apply.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures, 365-day term)

| Case | Full-term premium before | Full-term premium after | Days from change effective date to term end | Mid-term amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Location added | 6,000.00 | 7,825.00 | 146 | 1,825.00 multiplied by 146, divided by 365: 730.00, booked as an endorsement premium item |
| Location deleted | 7,825.00 | 6,000.00 | 146 | 730.00 credited, with the matching tax and stamping fee |
| Value increase | 5,000.00 | 6,000.00 | 100 | 1,000.00 multiplied by 100, divided by 365: 273.9726, rounded to 273.97 |

For the deletion case with hypothetical recorded rates of 5 percent tax and 0.2 percent stamping fee, the matching tax is 36.50 and the matching stamping fee is 1.46.

## Effective date of a deletion

A deletion takes effect on the date the signed request is received: a signed deletion request received on a hypothetical 12 August deletes the location from 12 August, and the days to term end are counted from that date.
